query: Plan a 4-day Egypt itinerary covering the essentials.
answer:
Here's an exciting **4-day itinerary** that covers the essentials of Egypt, from the bustling streets of Cairo to the ancient wonders of Luxor and the beautiful landscapes of Aswan!

---

### **Day 1 — Cairo: Ancient Treasures**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **The Egyptian Museum** — 2 hours — Explore the world’s largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, including treasures from Tutankhamun’s tomb. Arrive early to avoid crowds. **Ticket price: 200 EGP**.  
![The Egyptian Museum](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/the-egyptian-museum-0-1781614373.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Felfela Restaurant** — Enjoy traditional Egyptian dishes like koshari and falafel, located near Tahrir Square.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)** — 1.5 hours — Discover over 50,000 artifacts and the Royal Mummies Hall. Arrive early to see the mummies before the crowds. **Ticket price: 200 EGP**.  
![NMEC](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/national-museum-of-egyptian-civilization-nmec-0-1781568424.jpg)

• **Ben Ezra Synagogue** — 1 hour — Visit this medieval synagogue in Coptic Cairo, rich in history and significance. Entry is free, but donations are welcome.  
![Ben Ezra Synagogue](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/ben-ezra-synagogue-1-1781569653.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Tentmakers' Street** — Explore the vibrant street filled with hand-stitched textiles and crafts, perfect for souvenir shopping. Best visited in the late afternoon.  
![Tentmakers' Street](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/tentmakers-street-0-1781569400.jpg)

---

### **Day 2 — Luxor: The Valley of the Kings**

**Morning (8:00–12:00)**
• **Valley of the Kings** — 3 hours — Discover the tombs of ancient pharaohs, including that of Tutankhamun. Make sure to check for opening times and ticket prices.   
![Valley of the Kings](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e7/Valley_of_the_Kings_01.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Restaurant** — Enjoy a typical Egyptian lunch with dishes like grilled meats and salads.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Temple of Karnak** — 2 hours — Visit this vast temple complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world. Enjoy the magnificent pillars and obelisks.  
![Temple of Karnak](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/76/Karnak_Temple%2C_Luxor.jpg)

• **Luxor Museum** — 1 hour — Explore artifacts from the Theban temples and necropolis. **Ticket price: 140 EGP**.  
![Luxor Museum](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f5/Luxor_Museum.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Luxor Corniche** — Stroll along the beautiful waterfront promenade with cafes and stunning views of the Nile.

---

### **Day 3 — Aswan: Nubian Culture and Temples**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Temple of Dakka** — 2 hours — Visit this relocated Greco-Roman temple dedicated to Thoth. Enjoy a boat trip on Lake Nasser to reach it. **Ticket price: 100 EGP**.  
![Temple of Dakka](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/temple-of-dakka-0.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Nubian Restaurant** — Try traditional Nubian dishes like grilled fish while enjoying views of the Nile.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Aswan Souk** — 1.5 hours — Dive into the vibrant atmosphere of this traditional market filled with spices, textiles, and crafts. Bargaining is part of the experience!  
![Aswan Souk](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/aswan-souk-0.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Nile Felucca Ride** — Experience a serene sunset on a felucca boat on the Nile, a perfect way to unwind.

---

### **Day 4 — Abu Simbel Adventure**

**Early Morning (5:00–9:00)**
• **Abu Simbel Temples** — 3 hours (including travel) — Take an early morning trip to see the magnificent temples of Ramses II and Nefertari. It's about a 3-hour drive, so starting early is crucial. **Ticket price: 420 EGP**.  
![Abu Simbel](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/88/Vue_de_la_Fortresse_d%27Ibrym.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Lunch at Local Restaurant** — Enjoy a meal in Abu Simbel with local flavors.

**Afternoon (13:00–15:00)**
• **Qasr Ibrim** — Visit this unique island fortress, the only Nubian site remaining in its original location. You can appreciate it from a boat.  
![Qasr Ibrim](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/qasr-ibrim-0.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Return to Aswan** — Enjoy a leisurely dinner at a local restaurant, trying some traditional dishes.

---

### **Travel Tips**
- Wear comfortable shoes for walking at the sites.
- Stay hydrated and carry water, especially in the heat.
- Consider hiring local guides for deeper insights and history.
- Plan for early mornings, especially for trips like Abu Simbel.
